title: Pass Orchestrator v1 - Pass Plan
description: Machine-readable definition of one 'X Pass': an ordered set of sub-passes executed under the Pass Orchestrator lifecycle. See docs/pass-orchestrator.md for the full contract.

schema_version.description: Version of this pass-plan schema. Bump only on breaking format changes.

pass_id.description: Short, stable, kebab-case identifier for the whole X Pass. Used as a prefix in checkpoint commit messages.

pass_title.description: Human-readable title of the X Pass.

pass_branch.description: The single dedicated branch the entire X Pass lives on. Must never be 'main' or the repository's default branch.

base_branch.description: Branch that pass_branch was created from and will eventually be compared/reviewed against (e.g. 'main'). Never written to directly by the orchestrator.

goal.description: One paragraph describing the overall outcome the X Pass is meant to achieve.

global_constraints.description: Constraints that apply to every sub-pass in this plan (paths that must never change, behaviors that are always forbidden, etc.).

global_forbidden_paths.description: Glob-style paths that must never be modified by any sub-pass.

sub_passes.description: Ordered list of sub-passes. Executed strictly in array order; never reordered or parallelized.

title.description: Short human-readable title, also used verbatim in the checkpoint commit message.

objective.description: What this sub-pass must accomplish, scoped narrowly.

allowed_scope.description: Glob-style paths or descriptions of the only things this sub-pass may touch.

allowed_paths.description: Machine-checkable glob-style paths that are the only paths this sub-pass may modify.

forbidden_scope.description: Glob-style paths or explicit call-outs of things this sub-pass must NOT touch, even if convenient.

forbidden_paths.description: Machine-checkable glob-style paths that this sub-pass must not modify.

acceptance_criteria.description: Concrete, checkable statements that must all be true for this sub-pass to pass its gate.

validation.description: Shell commands or explicit manual checks to run to validate this sub-pass before the checkpoint commit. Prefix non-shell checks with 'manual:'.

visual_checks.description: Optional browser/visual/UI checks (e.g. via chrome-devtools tools) required for this sub-pass. Omit or leave empty for non-UI sub-passes.

final_validation.description: Validation performed once, after all sub-passes have passed, comparing base_branch..pass_branch as a whole.

requirements.description: Statements that must hold across the full pass (interaction between sub-passes, no unrelated changes, main untouched, etc.).

commands.description: Shell commands to run once at the end to validate the full diff from base_branch to HEAD of pass_branch.
